LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Idaho

Anglers aged 14 or older need a licence. Unlicensed visiting children must fish with a licence holder and share that person's catch limit.

  • First day$22.75 USD
  • Per consecutive day bought at the same time$7 USD
  • Annual$108 USD
  • 3 days$44.75 USD
